newsitem.title: USA: Applied says sees boost from acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Applied says sees boost from acquisition.

text.p: Applied Cellular Technology Inc said the completed acquisition of privately held Norcom Resources Inc by Applied's Universal Commodities unit is expected to add $20 to $25 million in revenue, and $0.03 to $0.05 to earnings per share, overall in 1997.
The transaction will have an effective accounting date of Jan. 1, 1997, and will be accounted for as a purchase, said the diversified technology company.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.

"ACTC believes the expanded group should have a significant favorable impact on its overall 1997 performance ... The earnings per share contribution is based upon the current weighted average share base of 7.4 million shares outstanding," the company said.
Norcom is a computer equipment brokerage company.
